stories.text: 🚨 RULED OUT: P. Washington won't play, and he's in Ramosverse's lineup. Next man up Josh Cameron is on waivers. Kickoff's Sunday 1 PM.
🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Joe's Scary Team has been laid to rest (14.72 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Mr. Action Jackson, playoff odds win/loss: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 46%/14%, Mr. Action Jackson 73%/39%.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Claremont In Yo Stace! 82% / 50%, The Mahomies 30% / 3.9%.
✅ CLINCHED: Brock You Like a Hurricane has locked up the #1 seed and a bye.
🛡️ SURVIVOR MATH: 1 of 3 still standing, 0.7 expected to survive (likely 0–1).
⚡ Early edge: Mr. Action Jackson went from 39% to 72% against Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy, led by Mumpfield (10.90 pts).
🔮 Ruffing the Passer vs Ramosverse is tightening — the projected margin shrank to 22.24 pts.
🔒 CLINCH WATCH: Brock You Like a Hurricane has all but locked up the #1 seed (99.5%).
📰 Sources: Bears expected to place TE Colston Loveland (knee) on IR. That's Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy's starting TE. Take note.
🚑 INJURY WARD: Mr. Action Jackson is absolutely slammed — Nacua (Rd 1) and Jackson (Rd 3) are out.
🗞️ Fresh off the wire: 49er Faith-Fool added Pat Freiermuth (TE, projected 7.65 pts), plus 2 more pickups.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 0.5% against Kirbo Crushers — and won.
💓 Brock You Like a Hurricane outlasted 49er Faith-Fool after the favorite flipped 9 times.
